completion.summary:
The bare done/evaluate ambiguity refusal is now bounded like the implicit-target conflict:
- held_refs and next show at most three held items, in ref order;
- the focus is always among them;
- details.more counts the rest;
- the message keeps the total ("holds 5 live claims: a, b, c and 2 more").
